cover_letter:
Hi Zicasso team,

The discovery-to-request journey is an especially compelling product challenge: every improvement needs to increase conversion without turning a premium experience into a generic transaction. That balance between user behavior, UX, experimentation, and business outcomes is where I have built my Growth experience.

At Meu Barzin, I led discovery and funnel analysis for an AI-powered conversational product. The data revealed a 43.9% first-message dropout and helped prioritize partner density and latency as critical bottlenecks. At AK Branding, I planned A/B tests across landing pages, messaging, ads, and interactions; UX and chatbot improvements increased leads from 8 to 20-30 per month (+250%).

At Wipro on the Meta Project, I worked in a squad using roadmap, backlog, OKRs, and global stakeholder input. I also owned AI adoption in the CRM, increasing usage by 150%, and used Power BI, Excel, and qualitative feedback to guide decisions.

I would value the opportunity to apply this combination of CRO, product, data, and AI to make Zicasso's journey even more personal, inspiring, and effective. I am available to work until 3 PM PT.

Kevin Augusto Vieira

form_answers.question: Tell us about a CRO experiment that delivered results.
form_answers.answer: At AK Branding, I planned A/B tests across landing pages, messaging, ads, and UX flows to validate acquisition and conversion hypotheses. In one context, UX and chatbot improvements increased lead capture from 8 to 20-30 leads per month (+250%). My approach is to define the hypothesis, metric, segment, analysis window, and criterion to scale, adjust, or stop.

form_answers.question: How do you prioritize a Growth backlog?
form_answers.answer: I combine expected impact, evidence confidence, effort, dependencies, and experience risk. On the Meta Project, I worked in a squad using roadmap, backlog, and OKRs to prioritize requests from clients, managers, product, and quality. At Meu Barzin, funnel data and interviews helped prioritize bottlenecks blocking conversion.

form_answers.question: How do you combine qualitative research and quantitative data?
form_answers.answer: I use data to locate the problem and research to understand why it happens. At Meu Barzin, analysis revealed a 43.9% first-message dropout; interviews and observation showed that partner density and API latency harmed the experience. That combination guided product priorities.

form_answers.question: How do you use AI in your product workflow?
form_answers.answer: I use LLMs for research, synthesis, documentation, prototyping, and automation. At Meu Barzin, I designed a conversational product using RAG, n8n, and Supabase with zero-hallucination rules. At Wipro, I owned CRM AI activation, increasing usage from 4 to 10 prompts per consultant (+150%).
